scope: Gulf/West Africa to East Asia, three compatible vessel classes, cost-free

opening_inputs.source_release_bbl: one nonnegative integer quantity at each physical origin
opening_inputs.new_requirements: unique immutable import requirement IDs, due turns and integer volumes
opening_inputs.export_limits_bbl: optional tighter source limits, never permission to create oil

trial_inputs.trial_ship_plan: ordered unique local open ship IDs per origin; ordering is respected
trial_inputs.trial_cargo_plan: desired loading amount from each origin's actual available oil
trial_inputs.ballast_orders: optional unique open-hull destination intents; not physical movements yet
trial_inputs.trial_inventory_plan: optional assertion of derived stocks by due turn, not an inventory adjustment

invariants: trial does not change physical snapshot, cargo, price history or inventory
one cargo demand, shared by all compatible vessel classes
one hull counted once across trial/reserve/committed/proposed capacity
local ship cannot be assigned to a different origin without actual ballast time
source oil cannot be relabelled as oil at a different origin
actual per-vessel load is positive and at most fixed vessel capacity
unused selected hulls remain in their physical port after commit
departure does not increase destination inventory; delivery does
reducing trial orders does not cancel independent import requirements
all supplied oil remains ashore, aboard a real hull, or delivered
hard infeasibility is reported and blocks commit, never clips stocks
the final trial quote is the frozen booked service reference
same final plan produces the same history regardless of intermediate trials

price_units.service_value: net transport service reference USD/bbl, not gross freight or cash
price_units.class_benchmark: same service value times class capacity divided by class reference cycle days
price_units.partial_load: service value times actual barrels; one full hull and voyage remain occupied

inventory.definition: recorded stock minus explicit normal stock
inventory.source: initial onshore oil plus releases minus actual loads
inventory.destination: initial stock plus actual deliveries minus independently due requirements
inventory.future: only known existing and proposed arrivals and explicitly supplied requirements
inventory.hard: feasibility envelope over actual chronological arrivals, not instant order totals

commit.semantics: atomic state version update and exactly-once snapshot consumption within this session
commit.persistence: settled checkpoint with spec and content hash
commit.limitation: separate sessions are simulation forks; distributed persistence requires its own conditional write
